scope: Eight Keys website plan; no game implementation is established by this file
title: The Eight Keys: Echoes of Jewel
status: planned; eight-PC play has not been verified

user_decisions.start: All eight roles play at the same time

proposed_setup.network: Venue-approved wired local network with enough switch ports for eight PCs and any uplink
proposed_setup.host: One of the eight player PCs hosts and also plays; the other seven join
proposed_setup.game_build: Same tested Windows game version on all eight PCs; release testing is pending
proposed_setup.staff: Check stations and roles, start when all are ready, assist with recovery and reset between groups
proposed_setup.shared_display: Optional; not needed for the proposed eight-PC setup

cooperative_rules: One student owns each role slot; no duplicate roles
Players enter different moments of Jewel's past and can start their tasks together
Keep the ordered checks inside each mission; co-op replaces the cross-role serial unlock rule
Keep existing single-player progression separate and intact
Timers start only after the player has control; unsafe actions earn no speed advantage
Verified completion adds that role's unique key once to shared team progress
Finished players can share clues; balance tasks to reduce idle time
All eight unique keys open the final door; the balcony gear repair restores the waterfall
Mechanical tests a contained loop and cannot restore the main waterfall by itself
review_and_test_targets: Choose a multiplayer world and level-loading design; separate role views do not establish independently working network maps
Two-player proof before eight-PC trial; preserve existing BIM slice and existing game review gates
Join, role selection, shared key awards and late join
Duplicate completion cannot add a second key
Host loss: explicit staff recovery or clean restart; no automatic host migration promise
Staff reset cannot carry one group's progress into the next
Inputs, loading and frame time on the actual event PCs with eight students
Round length and task balance set through playtests
Packaged acceptance remains pending; existing installer/toolchain/packaging hold is not lifted by this website request
